function.name: generate_image_tool
function.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

function.name: tts_tool
function.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

file_name.description: The name of the file to save the audio output without the extension. If left empty, a default name will be generated based on the content.

function.name: write_markdown_tool
function.description: Writes the provided content to a Markdown (.md) file on the disk. This function should be used when there is a need to persist text data in Markdown format as a result of a user action or a process that requires saving information in a structured text file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the Markdown content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: write_html_tool
function.description: Writes an HTML file to disk with the given content. Ensures HTML tags within the content are properly closed. This function should be used when there is a need to save HTML content to a file as part of a 'save' operation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: search_web_tool
function.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools, platforms, and APIs you can use to book flights—whether you’re building a bot, integrating into an app, or just looking for the best way to search and book.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it’s good for | Typical use case |
|----------|----------------|--------------------|------------------|
| **Consumer‑facing flight search & booking sites** | **Google Flights** | Fast, accurate search, price alerts | Personal travel planning |
| | **Skyscanner** | Multi‑carrier comparison, “everywhere” search | Budget travelers, flexible dates |
| | **Kayak** | Price alerts, price history, “flexible dates” | Travelers who want to see trends |
| | **Expedia / Hotels.com** | Bundled flight + hotel packages | Vacation planning |
| | **Priceline / Hotwire** | “Name Your Own Price” deals | Last‑minute or discounted bookings |
| | **Orbitz / Travelocity** | Loyalty points, bundled offers | Frequent travelers |
| | **Momondo** | Aggregates many low‑cost carriers | Finding hidden deals |
| | **CheapOair** | Direct booking, promo codes | Quick one‑off bookings |
| | **Trip.com / Ctrip** | Strong presence in Asia, multi‑currency | International travelers |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Flights + experiences bundled | Experiential travel |
| | **Travelocity** | Loyalty program, bundled offers | Frequent travelers |
| | **Booking.com Flights** | Integrated with hotel booking | One‑stop travel planning |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Real‑time flight tracking | Monitoring flight status |
| | **FlightAware** | Real‑time flight status, alerts | Business travelers |
| | **FlightStats** | Historical flight data, performance metrics | Airlines & travel agencies |
| | **Google Flights API (unofficial)** | Programmatic search (via scraping or unofficial API) | Developers building custom search |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search, price alerts, flight details | Integrate into apps or websites |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑city, multi‑carrier itineraries | Complex itineraries, travel agencies |
| | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, ancillary services | Enterprise travel solutions |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Booking, inventory, pricing | Airline & travel agency integration |
| | **Travelport APIs** | Booking, inventory, distribution | Global distribution system (GDS) |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data | Aviation analytics |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, historical data | Flight tracking apps |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight performance, delays, cancellations | Data‑driven travel services |
| | **AirLabs API** | Flight search, price alerts, flight status | Travel startups |
| | **Google Maps API (Directions)** | Add flight routes to maps | Visualizing itineraries |
| | **Python libraries** | `requests`, `beautifulsoup4`, `selenium` | Scrape or automate booking sites |
| | **Node.js libraries** | `puppeteer`, `axios` | Automate or scrape flight sites |
| | **Ruby gems** | `mechanize`, `nokogiri` | Web scraping for flight data |
| | **Java libraries** | `Jsoup`, `Selenium WebDriver` | Enterprise automation |
| | **C# libraries** | `HttpClient`, `HtmlAgilityPack` | .NET automation |
| | **Flight booking SDKs** | `Amadeus SDK`, `Sabre SDK` | Simplify API integration |
| | **Travel APIs** | `TripIt`, `Google Trips` | Sync itineraries |
| | **Chatbot platforms** | Dialogflow, Rasa, Botpress | Build conversational flight booking bots |
| | **Voice assistants** | Alexa Skills, Google Assistant Actions | Voice‑controlled flight booking |
| | **Payment gateways** | Stripe, PayPal, Braintree | Secure payment processing |
| | **CRM & ERP integrations** | Salesforce, SAP | Enterprise travel management |
| | **Data analytics** | Tableau, Power BI | Flight price trend analysis |
| | **Machine learning** | TensorFlow, PyTorch | Predictive pricing models |
| | **Cloud services** | AWS Lambda, Azure Functions | Serverless flight booking logic |
| | **Containerization** | Docker, Kubernetes | Deploy flight booking microservices |
| | **CI/CD pipelines** | GitHub Actions, GitLab CI | Continuous integration for flight booking apps |
| | **Testing frameworks** | Selenium, Cypress, Playwright | End‑to‑end testing of booking flows |
| | **Monitoring** | Prometheus, Grafana | Monitor booking service health |
| | **Security** | OAuth 2.0, JWT | Secure API access |
| | **Compliance** | GDPR, PCI DSS | Data protection & payment compliance |

### How to choose

| Need | Recommended tool(s) |
|------|---------------------|
| **Quick personal booking** | Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak |
| **Bundle flight + hotel** | Expedia, Priceline, Booking.com |
| **Last‑minute deals** | Hotwire, CheapOair |
| **International focus** | Trip.com, Skyscanner |
| **Developer API** | Amadeus, Skyscanner, Kiwi.com |
| **Enterprise GDS** | Sabre, Travelport |
| **Real‑time flight tracking** | FlightRadar24, FlightAware |
| **Custom chatbot** | Dialogflow + Amadeus API |
| **Voice booking** | Alexa Skill + Skyscanner API |
| **Data analytics** | FlightStats API + Tableau |
| **Automated testing** | Selenium + Cypress |

Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on any specific platform, API, or integration scenario!
